pecenjara-slon.shortDesc: Modern website for a premium grill restaurant that needed a strong digital presence aligned with the quality of their food.
pecenjara-slon.overview: Pečenjara Slon is a premium grill restaurant known for top-quality roasted meats and modern burger offerings. Without a digital presence, they were missing potential guests who search online for a real grilling experience.
pecenjara-slon.challenge: Create a website that is bold and welcoming at the same time — showcasing atmosphere, menu and quality in a way that attracts guests and communicates the brand clearly, without generic solutions.
deliverables: Custom web design aligned with brand identity

talentosphere.shortDesc: Professional multilingual website for a Croatian agency recruiting international workers.
talentosphere.overview: TalentoSphere is a Croatian agency specialising in placing workers from third countries with Croatian businesses. They needed a credible online platform that earns the trust of both employers and candidates.
talentosphere.challenge: Build a website that speaks equally to Croatian companies seeking workforce and international candidates seeking opportunities — presenting complex services in a clear, intuitive way.
deliverables: FAQ system for permits and procedures

delight-atelier.tagline: Mastery isn't adding complexity — it's the discipline of subtraction.
delight-atelier.shortDesc: Editorial luxury website for an artisan chocolate atelier with multilingual support.
delight-atelier.overview: Delight Atelier is an artisan confectionery atelier specialising in handcrafted chocolates made from single-origin Valrhona chocolate. Every detail — from ingredients to packaging — reflects an uncompromising commitment to quality.
delight-atelier.challenge: Translate the feeling of luxury craftsmanship into the digital space. Every design element had to communicate premium positioning — without excess, with the disciplined elegance that matches the product.
deliverables: Premium brand visual language and typography

elektro-light.shortDesc: Multilingual website for a licensed electrical services company in Zagreb with a lead generation system.
elektro-light.overview: Elektro Light is a licensed electrical services company offering 24/7 emergency and scheduled electrical work for residential and commercial properties in Zagreb. Transparency and reliability are the foundations of their brand.
elektro-light.challenge: Build a website that establishes trust — critical in the service industry — clearly presents services and actively generates leads, with multilingual support for the international clientele in Zagreb.
deliverables: Lead generation system with contact forms
